analysis.principle: Show a visible change through a concrete action
analysis.mechanism: Establish an initial state, then show the changed state so the audience can compare.

beats.observation: A blue block is visible on a plain surface.
beats.purpose: Establish the object and initial state.

beats.observation: The block is now beside a contrasting marker.

questions: What observable change can the new subject demonstrate?
transfer_rules: Choose a new subject and a visible before-and-after action.
avoid: Do not infer motion or sound from these still frames.
